observedOn: the two course-correction lab instances on the development box, each its own container, Docker network and volume with an ephemeral root key: `evimed-ovlab` (memory configuration) and `evimed-ovlab-kb` (the built-in bot behind the identity shim, hardened as production is). They held only records written for these recordings; no user memory or document was read or written.

The exchanges `apps/server/src/openVikingClient.mjs` makes through its five original calls, recorded on 2026-10-13 by running that client itself against `evimed-ovlab` — every request body is the one the client builds — and saved as the bare response body the server sent, re-indented. `find.json` is trimmed to its first three hits of four written; nothing was added, renamed or invented.
layout.memory/: 76 exchanges of native memory, sessions, the admin routes and the MCP endpoint, recorded by the memory lab against `evimed-ovlab`. Each file is `{ note, recordedFrom, request, status, contentType, response }`; `memory/_index.json` lists them and `memory/provenance.json` says how they were taken and what the wire disagreed with the documentation about.
layout.knowledge/: 54 response bodies (and one binary download) of resources, Compile, tasks, search and skills, recorded by the knowledge lab against `evimed-ovlab-kb`. Each file is the bare body; `knowledge/provenance.json` holds the method, path, request body and status of every one.

fixtureEvidence: Recording rather than authoring is deliberate: a hand-written fixture once certified a shape the wire never produced and defeated the audit that depended on it. The two subdirectories keep the shape their recorder wrote so that nothing was transcribed by hand on the way in.

observations: Trusted mode with root_api_key set requires X-API-Key on EVERY request, not only when asserting a role as the multi-tenant documentation implies. A client sending only the account and user headers is refused with UNAUTHENTICATED; find-unauthenticated.json is that refusal, unchanged since v0.4.19.

A `content/write` under `memories/` returns semantic_status 'skipped' and vector_status 'complete' even with a language model configured (content-write.json): the derived recall index costs one embedding per record and no model call. Directory abstracts under it read '[Directory abstract is not ready]' (fs-ls.json).

A find score is (cosine + 1) / 2, as since v0.4.22. On four records the relevant hit scored 0.894, a same-kind record about another habit 0.763, an unrelated analysis 0.700 and an unrelated note 0.623 (the fourth, trimmed from find.json). The production volume rehearsed under v0.5.0 on 2026-10-12 returned the same entries and hits as v0.4.19 with every score equal to (old + 1) / 2, so OPEN_SCIENCE_MEMORY_SEARCH_MIN_SCORE stays 0.75.

`ls` is not recursive. Listing `.../memories/evimed/user` on a tree written as `<kind>/<id>.md` returns the kind directories, each with `isDir: true` (fs-ls.json), not the leaves (fs-ls-leaves.json is one of them). `has_more` is a top-level key beside `result`. A missing directory answers 404 NOT_FOUND (fs-ls-missing.json).

A delete of something already gone answers 200 with `estimated_deleted_count: 0` (fs-delete-missing.json), not 404 as it did at v0.4.19. The client reads the count, so its callers' 'removed' counters stay true.

A user cannot delete its own namespace root (`viking://user/<id>`): 403 PERMISSION_DENIED 'Deleting a namespace root requires root access; use a concrete content path instead.' Everything below it can be deleted recursively.
/health reports `version`, `auth_mode` and `root_api_key_required` and is answered without a credential (health.json).

An unknown ov.conf key only warns at start (since v0.4.22); a memory-template directory that is not mounted is silent — the server falls back to its built-in types. The control plane therefore reads the engine's facts itself (apps/server/src/openVikingEngine.mjs): the per-type template route answers 400 'not editable' for a type the mounted directory added and 404 when the directory was not loaded.

In trusted mode the server forwards only X-API-Key to its Compile runtime and the bot refuses the request (401); with the identity shim the same submission completes. A submission whose target is outside every user's root is refused by the shim in about 0.3 s, the task ends `failed` with the shim's own sentence, and nothing is written — which is the no-spend probe the control plane uses.
The container tag is v0.5.0 while the PyPI version is 0.5.0; the unprefixed tag does not exist.
The server refuses to start in dev auth mode when bound to 0.0.0.0, which is why the deployment uses trusted mode rather than a localhost bind.
